conditions.label: ToolBench, governed
conditions.note: Gate on the RapidAPI category. Every gate-passing API also matches its soft scope (the category is in scope.tags), so the threshold cannot act.

conditions.label: ToolBench, ungated (no gov)
conditions.note: Empty scopes match every context, so every API is admissible. The trace rows show the operational pool (base 15). Before BEAR 0.4.2 (or with restore_dropped_rows) BM25 search also drops zero-score rows.

conditions.label: ToolBench, mandatory-only (supplementary)
conditions.note: Governed corpus, context without tags. The gate fails closed, so nothing is admissible. No mandatory tags are configured.

conditions.label: MetaTool base (no tags)
conditions.note: Soft scope is the tool's own name and queries carry no tags, so admission is sim >= theta alone. All priorities are 50.

conditions.label: MetaTool+Tags, governed
conditions.note: required_tags = scope.tags = the tool's generated tags. A tool passes only if all its tags are in the query context.
